ses.window.title: Sessions
ses.list.new.help: Hand items from a project to Claude Code or Codex in a new session
ses.list.empty.title: No sessions yet
ses.list.empty.body: Items you hand off to an agent run here as sessions, grouped by project.
ses.header.app_runner.help: tmux isn’t installed, so this session runs inside Blurt. Install tmux (brew install tmux) to keep sessions running after you quit.
ses.header.open_external.help: Open this session in your terminal app
ses.header.review.help: See what changed on the branch, then merge it, open a pull request or discard it
ses.end.title: End this session?
ses.end.body: The agent stops and its terminal window closes. Changes it already made stay where they are.
ses.overlay.detached.title: Disconnected
ses.overlay.detached.body: The session is still running. Reconnect to pick up where it is.
ses.overlay.elsewhere.title: Shown in another window
ses.overlay.elsewhere.body: This session runs inside Blurt and is showing in another window.
ses.overlay.pick: Select a session to see its terminal.
ses.overlay.empty.title: Your agents work here
ses.overlay.empty.body: Hand items to Claude Code or Codex. Each works in its own terminal, and Blurt tells you when one needs you.
ses.overlay.ended.title: Session ended
ses.overlay.ended.review_hint: The agent’s changes are on their own branch, waiting for you.
ses.overlay.ended.verify_hint: Its items are now waiting for you to verify. Mark them done once you’ve checked.
ses.overlay.ended.unreported_hint: The agent didn’t report back, so its items are still in progress. Once you’ve looked, mark them done or take them back.
ses.dispatch.title: Hand Off to Agent
ses.dispatch.subtitle.none: Choose the items to work on
ses.dispatch.agent.none: No agent that can run a session is installed. Install Claude Code or Codex, then check again in Settings, under Agents.
ses.dispatch.pick.empty: Nothing to do in this project. Pick another project above.
ses.warning.concurrent_edit: Another session is already changing files in {a}. Editing the same files at the same time can cause conflicts — a separate branch keeps them apart.
ses.warning.no_git: This folder isn’t a git repository, so the agents work in it directly.
ses.warning.no_tmux: tmux isn’t installed: the session runs inside Blurt and ends when you quit it.
ses.warning.draft_confirmed: Items that are still new are accepted when you hand them off.
ses.finish.title: Review Changes
ses.finish.subtitle: {a} → {b}
ses.finish.help: Merge brings the branch into {a} in your project folder. Nothing is pushed unless you open a pull request.
ses.finish.merge.help: Merge into {a} and remove the worktree
ses.finish.pr.help: Push the branch and open a pull request
ses.finish.keep.help: Leave the branch and worktree as they are
ses.finish.discard.confirm.title: Discard these changes?
ses.finish.discard.confirm.body: The worktree and the branch {a} are deleted. This can’t be undone.
ses.finish.done.keep: Kept. You can review it again from the session.
ses.finish.done.pushed: Branch pushed to origin. No pull request was opened — open one on your Git host.
ses.finish.done.compare: Branch pushed. Finish the pull request in your browser:
ses.finish.done.verify: Its items are waiting for you to verify.
ses.error.unknown: That didn’t work. Try again; if it keeps failing, the details are in the log.
ses.error.timeout: The session command took too long.
ses.error.missing_dependency: tmux or git is missing on this computer.
ses.error.no_sessions_cli: This version of the Blurt skill can’t run sessions yet. Update the skill, then try again.
ses.error.uv_missing: uv isn’t installed. Blurt needs it to run its tools; the setup assistant can install it.
ses.error.no_window: The session’s terminal window has closed.
ses.error.app_runner_lost: This session ran inside Blurt and ended when Blurt quit.
ses.error.needs_project: These items aren’t in a project with a folder yet. Move them to a project first.
ses.error.mixed_projects: The items belong to different projects. Hand off one project at a time.
ses.error.deleted: Discarded items can’t be handed off.
ses.error.bad_agent: That agent isn’t set up for sessions.
ses.error.conflict: The merge stopped on conflicts and was undone. The branch is untouched — resolve it in the worktree or open a pull request.
ses.error.dirty: Your project folder has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then merge.
ses.error.wrong_branch: Your project folder isn’t on the branch this work started from. Switch back to it, then merge.
ses.error.push: Pushing the branch failed. Check your connection and access to the remote.
ses.error.no_remote: This repository has no remote to open a pull request on.
ses.error.no_worktree: This session didn’t use a worktree.
ses.error.app_runner: This session runs inside Blurt; open it in Blurt’s own window.
ses.error.bad_args: The session command was called the wrong way.
ses.error.no_agent: No agent that can run a session is installed and signed in.
ses.error.no_git: This folder isn’t a git repository, so there’s no branch to review.
ses.error.no_terminal: None of the supported terminal apps is installed.
ses.error.gone: This session has ended, or its folder is gone.
ses.error.running: The agent is still running in this worktree. End the session first.
ses.error.uncommitted: The worktree has uncommitted changes. Ask the agent to commit them, or commit them yourself, then try again.
ses.take_back.changes_kept: Taken back. The session’s changes are still on its branch: review them first.
ses.overlay.failed_start.title: {a} couldn’t start
ses.overlay.failed.title: {a} stopped with an error
ses.overlay.no_changes.title: Ended with no changes
ses.error.commit: Committing the agent’s changes failed — a git hook may have refused them. Commit them in the worktree, then try again.
ses.error.has_changes: This session left changes. Review them first.
ses.error.already_dispatched: These items are already in a running session.
ses.overlay.review.title: Ready to review
ses.dispatch.desktop.send: In {a}, confirm the folder and press Send.
ses.dispatch.desktop.no_mcp: The blurt MCP isn’t installed for {a}, so the agent can’t report progress. Without it, mark the items yourself when they’re done.
ses.end_desktop.title: Stop following this session?
ses.end_desktop.body: The conversation in {a} goes on. Its items stay as they are: mark them yourself when they’re done.
ses.continue_desktop.title: Continue in {a} desktop?
ses.continue_desktop.body: The agent stops in Blurt’s terminal and the same conversation opens in {a}. Blurt no longer shows its live status: progress comes from the agent.
ses.continue_desktop.body_nomcp: The agent stops in Blurt’s terminal and the same conversation opens in {a}. The blurt MCP isn’t installed there, so the agent can’t report progress: mark the items yourself when they’re done, or install it first.
ses.overlay.desktop.body_nomcp: This conversation’s live status isn’t shown here, and the blurt MCP isn’t installed for {a}, so the agent can’t report progress. Mark the items yourself when they’re done.
ses.error.desktop_no_mcp: The blurt MCP isn’t installed for the desktop app, so progress can’t be reported from there.
ses.overlay.desktop.title: Working in {a}
ses.overlay.desktop.body: This conversation’s live status isn’t shown here. Items update when the agent reports progress.
ses.overlay.desktop.body_continued: This session moved here from Blurt’s terminal. Its live status isn’t shown any more; progress comes from the agent.
ses.row.desktop.no_mcp: In {a} desktop · waiting for you to mark it
ses.error.no_desktop: This agent has no desktop app to hand items to.
ses.error.desktop_version: This needs a newer Claude Code (2.1.285 or later).
ses.error.desktop_login: This needs Claude Code signed in with a Claude subscription.
ses.error.desktop_unsupported: This agent can’t continue in a desktop app.
ses.error.desktop_failed: The desktop app didn’t take over the conversation, and the agent here has stopped. Restart Session starts a new session on these items in Blurt’s terminal.
ses.error.no_session_id: The agent hasn’t reported its conversation yet. Try again in a moment.
ses.error.bad_runner: Only a session running in Blurt’s terminal can do that.
ses.error.auth: {a} isn’t signed in. Sign in, then start again.
ses.error.auth.fix: {a} isn’t signed in: {b}. Then start again.
ses.error.bad_transition: These items are waiting to be verified or are done. Reopen them to hand them off again.
ses.error.finished: This session has already been dealt with.
ses.error.already_dispatched.named: {a} is already in a running session.
ses.error.io: Blurt couldn’t read or write a file it needs. Try again.
ses.error.unparseable: An item’s file can’t be read. Fix it in an editor first.
ses.error.not_found: These items can’t be found any more. They may have been moved or deleted.
ses.error.locked: Something else is running. Try again in a moment.
ses.warning.taken_back: Their last session has ended: the items are taken back from it and handed to the new one.
ses.warning.taken_back.one: Its last session has ended: the item is taken back from it and handed to the new one.
ses.agents.fix.then: Then come back and check again.
ses.handoff.branch.on: Changes stay on a branch until you merge them.
ses.handoff.branch.parallel: Each item gets its own branch.
ses.handoff.branch.off: Edits the project folder directly. The agent won’t commit.
ses.handoff.branch.no_git: Not a git repository, so the agent edits it directly.
ses.handoff.branch.help: A git worktree next to the project. When it’s done, you merge it, open a pull request or discard it.
ses.handoff.note.todo.one: {a} is new: handing it off accepts it.
ses.handoff.note.todo.many: Handing off accepts the items that are still new.
ses.review.gone.title: This session no longer exists
ses.review.gone.body: It was removed, so there are no changes to review.
ses.handoff.pick.heading: To Do
ses.handoff.branch.locked: Required when items run side by side.
ses.handoff.run_in.desktop.detail: Progress comes from the agent’s reports
ses.handoff.block.logged_out: {a} isn’t signed in, so it can’t start.
ses.handoff.block.no_agent: No agent that can run a session is installed.
ses.handoff.note.todo.count: {a} items · {b} new, accepted when handed off
ses.overlay.gone.title: Its folder is gone
ses.overlay.gone.body: The branch’s folder was deleted, so there’s nothing left to review.
ses.review.folder_gone.title: Its folder is gone
ses.review.folder_gone.body: It was deleted, so there are no changes left to review.
ses.review.no_worktree.title: Nothing to review
ses.review.no_worktree.body: This session worked in the project folder directly.
ses.finish.end_review.help: Ends {a}, then shows its changes again, including any it made on the way out. You merge after that.
ses.error.changed: The branch changed after this review opened. Review it again before you merge.
ses.error.outdated: This agent is too old for hand-offs. Update it, then check again.
ses.handoff.block.outdated: {a} {b} is too old for hand-offs (needs {c} or later). Update it in a terminal, then check again.
ses.hint.trust: {a} asks once per repository whether to trust this folder: answer below to let it start.
ses.hint.hooks: {a} asks once whether to trust its hooks: choose Trust all so Blurt can follow along.
ses.overlay.stopped_trust.title: {a} stopped at its trust question
ses.overlay.stopped_trust.body: It asked whether to trust this folder and the answer was No, so it closed. Restart the session and choose Yes.
ses.overlay.merged.verify_hint: Merged into {a} · {b} is waiting for you to verify.
ses.overlay.pr.verify_hint: {a} is waiting for you to verify once the pull request is merged.
ses.finish.uncommitted_one: Blurt commits the {n} uncommitted change on this branch first.
ses.finish.uncommitted_other: Blurt commits the {n} uncommitted changes on this branch first.
ses.finish.done.discard_taken_back_one: Discarded. Its item is back in To do.
ses.finish.done.discard_taken_back_other: Discarded. Its {n} items are back in To do.
ses.header.app_runner.help.win: On Windows, sessions run inside Blurt, so this one ends when you quit Blurt.
ses.header.app_runner.help.linux: tmux isn’t installed, so this session runs inside Blurt. Install tmux to keep sessions running after you quit.
